title: plasmashell loses focus too easily in cases where the user probably want to keep it there instead of focusing thewindow at the top of the window stack
line: Closing the Application Launcher by clicking its icon over a fullscreen app no longer makes an auto-hide panel vanish from under the pointer.
explanation: When a panel popup such as Kickoff closes, KWin activates the next window in the focus chain. If that window is fullscreen, becoming active again puts it in the active-fullscreen layer above panels, so it covers the panel the pointer is resting on; plasmashell then gets a Leave event and the auto-hide panel hides at once. Without a fullscreen window the panel stays above and remains shown, hence the inconsistency. Now, when an applet popup closes while the pointer is over a panel and the next candidate is a fullscreen window on that screen, KWin leaves focus unset, so the panel stays shown like it does without fullscreen windows; clicking the fullscreen app focuses it and covers the panel again.

commits.message:
activation: keep the panel shown when its popup closes over fullscreen

Closing a panel popup by clicking its applet handed focus back to a
fullscreen window, which then covered the panel under the pointer and
made an auto-hide panel vanish; focus now stays unset in that case.

BUG: 519796

From 148ce32d0816b9d4de001a12ef836970a8cfec27 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>

Subject: [PATCH] activation: keep the panel shown when its popup closes over
 fullscreen

Closing a panel popup by clicking its applet handed focus back to a
fullscreen window, which then covered the panel under the pointer and
made an auto-hide panel vanish; focus now stays unset in that case.

BUG: 519796
---
 src/activation.cpp | 7 +++++++
 1 file changed, 7 insertions(+)

diff --git a/src/activation.cpp b/src/activation.cpp
index 9bcb216855..5e27f133b0 100644
--- a/src/activation.cpp
+++ b/src/activation.cpp
@@ -474,6 +474,13 @@ void Workspace::activateNextWindow(Window *window)
         if (focusCandidate == nullptr) { // last chance: focus the desktop
             focusCandidate = findDesktop(desktop, output);
         }
+
+        // an active fullscreen window would cover the panel the pointer is on
+        if (window && window->isAppletPopup() && focusCandidate && focusCandidate->isFullScreen() && focusCandidate->isOnOutput(output)) {
+            if (Window *underMouse = windowUnderMouse(output); underMouse && underMouse->isDock()) {
+                focusCandidate = nullptr;
+            }
+        }
     }
 
     if (focusCandidate) {

media.caption: Fullscreen Konsole, auto-hide panel: Meta opens Kickoff, clicking the launcher icon closes it and the panel disappears with the pointer still on it.
Same steps: after Kickoff closes the panel stays shown under the pointer.
1 s after closing Kickoff by its icon: panel gone, pointer still on the launcher.
3 s after closing Kickoff by its icon: panel still shown.

review.text: The cause is identified correctly: the re-activated fullscreen window goes to ActiveLayer above the dock (AboveLayer) and covers the panel under the pointer. But the fix works around that by leaving no window focused at all, keyed on a popup closing with a dock under the mouse; KWin maintainers are unlikely to accept a null-focus special case in activateNextWindow, and it also leaves keyboard input going nowhere when the popup is closed with Escape while the pointer rests on the panel. The proper fix is in the stacking, not in focus.
changes: Drop the focusCandidate = nullptr special case in activateNextWindow.

Fix it in KWin's layering instead: keep a dock that is currently shown above the active fullscreen window while the pointer is on it (e.g. a revealed auto-hide/layer-shell panel stays above ActiveLayer until the pointer leaves), so focus can still go back to the fullscreen app.
Re-test Escape-closing Kickoff with the pointer on the panel, and closing it by its icon, both over fullscreen.
